Eye Pattern - Sectoral Heterochromia.description:
👁️ Eye Pattern: Sectoral Heterochromia
Part of one iris is a different color from the rest — a wedge or sector of your secondary eye color within the primary.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Eye Pattern - Sectoral Heterochromia.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Each iris shows two distinct color zones — the base iris color interrupted by a contrasting sector of the secondary eye color. Apply sectoral heterochromia using primary and secondary eye colors. Do not turn this into active power use.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
